trajan.definition: n. Roman Emperor and adoptive son of Nerva; extended the Roman Empire to the east and conducted an extensive program of building (53-117)
trajan.translation: 图拉真(Marcus Ulpius Trajanus, 52?-117, 罗马皇帝, 在位期间 98-117)

traject.definition:
v. t. To throw or cast through, over, or across; as, to
   traject the sun's light through three or more cross prisms.
v. t. A place for passing across; a passage; a ferry.
v. t. The act of trajecting; trajection.
v. t. A trajectory.
traject.translation: 传导, 传达, 通过, 输送

trajected.translation:
vt. 传达；通过；输送
n. 穿越；过渡航道

trajecting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Traject
trajecting.translation:
vt. 传达；通过；输送
n. 穿越；过渡航道

trajection.definition:
n. The act of trajecting; a throwing or casting through or
   across; also, emission.
n. Transposition.

trajectories.translation: n. <物>弹道( trajectory的名词复数 ); 轨道; <数>轨线; 常角轨道

trajectory.definition: n. the path followed by an object moving through space
trajectory.translation:
n. 轨道, 弹道, 轨线
[化] 轨道
